observation.visible_scene: A top-down static view of a wooden floor on which dominoes are arranged to spell "THE END" in white tiles resting on a rainbow-colored standing base, plus a white domino trail that forms a U-shaped loop around the right and bottom of the text and a separate straight white trail at the upper left. The clip captures a chain-reaction collapse of these dominoes.
visible_changes: At t=0 the white "THE" letters and the surrounding white loop are upright; within the first few frames the "THE" white tiles and the rainbow base directly beneath them begin tilting and fall.

The collapse then propagates into the white loop: the right vertical segment of the loop falls first (roughly t=0.16–0.48), followed by the bottom horizontal segment falling right-to-left (roughly t=0.48–0.80), then the left curved end of the loop falling (roughly t=0.80–1.04).

After the loop's left end drops, the white "END" letters and their rainbow base begin to fall from left to right: the "E" tilts first (around t=1.04–1.20), then the "N" (around t=1.24–1.36), then the "D" (around t=1.36–1.60); by the last frame the "D" is still only partially collapsed.
The straight white trail at the upper-left remains standing and unchanged throughout the entire excerpt.
The camera position and framing stay constant; all apparent motion is the falling of the dominoes, not camera movement.
outside_clip_unknowns: What initiated the first fall of the "THE" tiles (the trigger lies before the cropped segment).
The final resting state of the "END" letters, since the "D" has not finished collapsing by the last frame.
Whether the upper-left straight trail ever falls later, as it is unaffected within this segment.
uncertain_details: The exact physical contact linking the right edge of the "THE" rainbow base to the top of the white loop is not directly visible; the loop's right side simply begins falling shortly after the "THE" region collapses.
The precise frame at which each individual tile tips is approximate due to the 0.04 s sampling interval.
